elaine-support: Customer AcmePay reports 400 on /v1/tools/invoke -> JSON schema validation. Happening after SDK 2.3.0 upgrade. Error message: `ValidationError: params.metadata: expected object but got array; params.billing_profile.id: required; additionalProperties 'session'`. Attaching payload they sent.

sophie-eng: Can you paste the exact request body + SDK version? Also customer org id?

elaine-support: SDK `redwood-js@2.3.0`, org `acme-pay-01`. Here's payload they sent:
```json
{
  "tool": "charge_invoice",
  "params": {
    "billing_profile": {
      "id": null
    },
    "metadata": ["env","prod"],
    "session": []
  }
}
```

sophie-eng: ok reproducer looks straightforward. Root cause: our function schema for `charge_invoice` defines `params.metadata` as an object (map string->string) and requires `params.billing_profile.id`. `additionalProperties: false` on params means `session` is rejected. The SDK change started attaching `session` as an empty array when missing. Also billing_profile.id being `null` triggers the required/type mismatch.

dave-devex: this is likely the recent client change. Quick workaround for customers: send `"session": null` or remove the key. We'll push a small gateway shim to coerce `[]`->`{}` and strip unknown keys for a short window.

sophie-eng: repro curl for local testing:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tools/invoke \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"tool":"charge_invoice","params":{"billing_profile":{"id":null},"metadata":["env","prod"],"session":[]}}'
```

maria-ml: does this affect tool selection logic? i.e. could metadata array cause a different tool to be chosen? not in this case — selection is based on prompt content, schema validation happens after selection.

kevin-oncall: creating incident INC-2026-487, marking P2. Plan: 1) gateway shim (coerce arrays->objects, remove session array) 2) hotfix in JS SDK to stop sending `session: []` 3) update function schema to be more tolerant for metadata if needed. Rolling canary now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot started canary deploy of gateway-validate v2.3.1 to us-west-2 (3/4 hosts)

elaine-support: Customer confirmed after gateway patch + asking them to update SDK. They reported success: no more 400s. Closing interim workaround, tracking SDK patch in #devex. :thumbsup:

sophie-eng: follow-up action: add schema regression test for `charge_invoice` with arrays and nulls. Init PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/972

kevin-oncall: Thanks everyone. Will update INC ticket with root cause & timeline. :white_check_mark:
